overview_description.description: ZEPTO is a SaaS product which can derive business insights using AI/ML technologies from tabular formatted data. This also includes an intuitive visualization area with analytics capabilities using intelligent algorithms. This is mainly to make analytics a truly self-serviceable thing for small businesses. Furthermore, our AI Driven platform enables SMBs to interpret their data in a meaningful way - one of the biggest reasons as to why SMBs don't really use analytics currently.
